'''Akeeli Somerce''' was the assistant to the [[Prex]], [[Chils Meplin]]. She was dispatched to discreetly kill [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla|Fiolla]] and [[Naven Crel]] after the latter learned about Meplin's leaking of CSA secrets to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While Somerce was able to surprise the pair, Fiolla stalled her long enough for Crel to use Fiolla's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to kill Somerce. However, Somerce did manage to inflict a mortal wound on Crel before being killed.
